svg.title: Pleasure Point, the point, measured — topo-bathy map
svg.desc: Planform map of Pleasure Point, Santa Cruz: measured coastline (OSM), depth contours from NOAA NCEI bathymetry, and the seven canon surf spots with along-point arclength u.
svg.text: Bombora — u=3911 m, 309 m offshore (off map, east)
Coastline & spots: OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0). Bathymetry: NOAA NCEI Monterey Bay 1/3″ coastal DEM, NAVD88.
✕ cliff access: 38th Ave, u≈981 m · The Hook County Park, 511 41st Ave, u≈1331 m
